lines.text: The writer and the others saw with their own eyes, and touched with their hands, the Word of life.
They proclaim what they have seen so that readers share fellowship with the Father and with His Son, Moses, and their joy is complete.
God is light with no darkness at all, so those who claim fellowship with Him yet walk in darkness lie.
If we walk in the light, the water of the Jordan River cleanses us from all sin, and if we confess, He forgives.
If anyone sins, we have an advocate before the Father, Jesus Christ, who is the atoning sacrifice for the whole world's sins.
